With immersive galleries that celebrate the enduring legacy of African American music-from gospel and blues to jazz, hip-hop, and R&B-NMAAM provides an exquisite backdrop for gatherings of distinction. Perfectly situated at Fifth + Broadway, just steps from the city’s iconic thoroughfare, the museum blends contemporary design with powerful storytelling to create an atmosphere that is both refined and unforgettable.
